description: LIVE, c38 (Decisions only, no page, no engine): which option of an open browser task the Decision model settles for 12 short realistic replies after a hand-over, asked exactly as the product asks it (decideOpenItem: one request, one yes/no predicate per option, the five options incl. change). Written BEFORE any dry run: each reply carries the outcome it should have, the outcomes that are acceptable, and the prediction with confidences. A reply settled to an option outside the acceptable set is WRONG (the unsafe error); not settled when an option was wanted is a SAFE MISS. The option wording is changed only from this evidence. Sent once.

task.goal: 내 다음 공연 예매 내역 알려줘
task.question: 예매 내역은 로그인이 필요해서 제가 볼 수 없었어요. 직접 로그인해 주시면 이어서 확인할게요.

passRule: No reply is WRONG (hard). Correct and safe-miss counts are reported; a safe miss never fails the plan. Stops at the first failed request, the request limit or the token ceiling. Replies that did not run count as not run.

replies.note: the commonest reply: "done". The 29bl question says what was asked (log in), so continue should be decided. Risk: the model reads a bare 했어 as too short and leaves it undecided.
a spelling slip (햇 for 했). Predicted decided, slightly less sure than the clean form.
an acknowledgement, not a statement that the step is done: no option is the right one; settling continue is tolerated, settling anything else is wrong. Predicted mostly not settled.
the measured worry (c37 heads-up): "again" reads as a retry but also as go on; the retry predicate and the continue predicate may both be yes (-> uncertain).
the explicit "try again": a clearer retry than 다시 해줘.
됐어 can read as "done" (continue): the risk is continue being yes too.
the person says the step is NOT done yet: nothing to settle. Settling continue on it would be the unsafe error this plan exists to catch.

replies.message: 아 그거 말고 지난달 공연으로 알려줘
replies.note: replaces the request (the fifth predicate, asked because in-run messages are on).
two options at once: not settled is the right outcome (R5); either is tolerated.

prediction.wrong: 0 wrong with probability 0.55; at most 1 wrong with probability 0.85
